html:
Teeth Whitening

Professional Teeth Whitening in Kansas City, MO

Tooth discoloration is common among people. Whether your teeth are slightly yellowed or darkened, you may want a solution to lighten and brighten them. If you require treatment beyond store-bought whiteners, please reach out to Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport. Our teeth whitening in Kansas City, MO is conducted by trained, licensed, and experienced dentists and hygienists. Our office is outfitted with innovative dental technology and a skilled team that deploys the latest methods and techniques. We offer solutions from the most renowned industry brands. We will happily consult you on our whitening options and help you choose the right one for your needs.
Contact Us

Whitening Trays for a Beautiful Smile

Our teeth whitening options include:

  • Opalescence Boost: We provide this treatment at our office and complete it within an hour. All we need to do is apply a fast-acting gel that generates results almost instantly, and then we'll send you home.
  • Opalescence PF: Opalescence PF is administered at home by you. First, our team will customize whitening trays to fit your mouth and teeth. We'll provide the gels and solutions you need, which you can use to whiten your smile at your convenience.
  • Opalescence Go: These highly flexible whitening trays can be applied at home or in our office. They are made from a bendable material that conforms to your mouth's shape, size, and contour.

Are You Ready to Smile Again?

If you have discolored teeth, you've likely been reluctant to smile. Your smile is an expression of who you are. You should always feel free and confident in showing it off to yourself and others. With Cosmetic and Implant Dentistry Westport's whitening solutions, you no longer have to live with yellowing or darkened teeth. Choose from our in-office and take-home solutions according to your goals, comfort, and convenience. We'll explain our solutions' unique benefits to help you determine the right choice. Our team will achieve your desired tooth color and shade in little to no time. Enjoy a new-and-improved and one-of-a-kind smile.

Choose Us for the Perfect Smile

Call Now
